sentences.zh: 据法庭文件显示，他因参与一起入室抢劫案而被捕。

sentences.en: And so he pleads guilty to aggravated robbery with a deadly weapon.
sentences.zh: 他承认了持致命武器加重抢劫罪。

sentences.en: He's sentenced to five years in state prison.
sentences.zh: 他被判处五年州立监狱监禁。

sentences.en: He only serves four years.
sentences.zh: 他只服刑了四年。

sentences.en: And he's released in 2013.
sentences.zh: 并于2013年获释。

sentences.en: And after he's released from prison, you know, he really starts to turn his life around.
sentences.zh: 出狱后，你知道，他真的开始洗心革面了。

sentences.en: He becomes more religious.
sentences.zh: 他变得更加虔诚。

sentences.en: George Floyd has a daughter who's born around that time after he gets out of prison.
sentences.zh: 乔治·弗洛伊德在出狱后不久有了个女儿。

sentences.en: And it turns out what we learned at the funeral is that he actually had five children and two grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 我们在葬礼上了解到，他实际上有五个孩子和两个孙辈。

sentences.en: And he starts reconnecting with his kids.
sentences.zh: 他开始重新与孩子们建立联系。

sentences.en: He starts speaking out about and against gun violence.
sentences.zh: 他开始公开谈论并反对枪支暴力。

sentences.en: And he becomes this almost this like unofficial community leader back in the king's homes, back in third ward.
sentences.zh: 他几乎成了基尼家园、成了第三区（Third Ward）非官方的社区领袖。

sentences.en: And he has a lot of respect out there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里备受尊重。

sentences.en: And then eventually he gets plugged into this program that will eventually take him to Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 最终，他加入了一个项目，这个项目后来将他带到了明尼阿波利斯。

sentences.en: We've been criticized for not writing about and publicizing more the details of his criminal history.
sentences.zh: 我们曾因没有更多地撰写和公开他的犯罪记录细节而受到批评。

sentences.en: I think some people have this worldview where if you're an ex-con, then you're an ex-con and that's all you'll ever be in your life.
sentences.zh: 我认为有些人有这样一种世界观：如果你曾是罪犯，那你永远都是罪犯，这就是你一生所能定义的一切。

sentences.en: And the people in the CUNY homes, a lot of them have run-ins with law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 而基尼家园的人，他们中很多人都曾与执法部门有过冲突。

sentences.en: But, you know, your life moves on after that and people change.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，生活在那之后会继续，人也会改变。

sentences.en: And so I think, you know, it's sort of a balance to try to write about the totality of somebody's life,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你知道，试图去书写一个人的一生全貌是一种平衡，

sentences.en: the good and the bad, and try to do that in a way that honors the memory of a person
sentences.zh: 包括好的和坏的，并试图以一种尊重逝者记忆的方式去书写，

sentences.en: whose reason for being in the news has to do with him being a victim of a crime and not the perpetrator of one.
sentences.zh: 因为他出现在新闻中是因为他是一起犯罪的受害者，而不是肇事者。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So tell me about George Floyd's final years and his final chapter.
sentences.zh: 那么跟我说说乔治·弗洛伊德最后的岁月和他生命的最后一章吧。

sentences.en: You know, he has a pretty quiet life in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在明尼阿波利斯过着相当平静的生活。

sentences.en: He's living with roommates.
sentences.zh: 他和室友住在一起。

sentences.en: He's working as a security guard at a nightclub.
sentences.zh: 他在一家夜总会当保安。

sentences.en: He has a girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 他有一个女朋友。

sentences.en: He's still very religious, reading the Bible.
sentences.zh: 他依然非常虔诚，经常读圣经。

sentences.en: And he has this sort of quiet life.
sentences.zh: 他过着这种安静的生活。

sentences.en: You know, he called it his new chapter in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他称之为他在明尼阿波利斯的新篇章。

sentences.en: The people who knew him here in Houston say they thought he was pretty happy out there.
sentences.zh: 那些在休斯敦认识他的人说，他们觉得他在那里过得挺开心的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，去探索《时报》呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So that's George Floyd, the person.
sentences.zh: 这就是作为个人的乔治·弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: And like you said, there's also George
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，还有作为

sentences.en: Floyd, the symbol and the beginning of a movement.
sentences.zh: 象征和运动开端的乔治·弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: So how did those two ideas of him play out during his funeral today?
sentences.zh: 那么，这两个关于他的概念在今天的葬礼上是如何体现的呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the funeral is at a church in Houston called the Fountain of Praise.
sentences.zh: 葬礼在休斯敦的一座名为“赞美之泉”（Fountain of Praise）的教堂举行。

sentences.en: And the media wasn't allowed inside.
sentences.zh: 媒体不被允许进入内部。

sentences.en: And so I spent most of the day outside talking to people.
sentences.zh: 所以我大部分时间都在外面和人们交谈。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We want to bring greetings to everyone who is within the sanctuary walls, as well as those who are watching via stream or some platform today.
sentences.zh: 我们要向所有在圣殿内的人，以及今天通过直播或平台观看的人致以问候。

sentences.en: But it was live streamed.
sentences.zh: 但葬礼进行了直播。

sentences.en: In the tradition of the African-American church, this will be a home going celebration.
sentences.zh: 按照非裔美国人教会的传统，这将是一场“归家庆典”。

sentences.en: Come on, I want to say it again.
sentences.zh: 来吧，我想再说一遍。

sentences.en: This will be a home going celebration of Brother George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 这将是乔治·弗洛伊德兄弟的归家庆典。

sentences.en: And here you had, you know, a number of elected officials, including many of the African-American political leaders in Houston and in Texas.
sentences.zh: 在这里，你知道，有许多民选官员，包括休斯敦和得克萨斯州的许多非裔美国人政治领袖。

sentences.en: Let me just briefly say, let me, on behalf of the city of Houston.
sentences.zh: 请允许我简短地说几句，代表休斯敦市。

sentences.en: Mayor Turner of Houston spoke.
sentences.zh: 休斯敦市长特纳发表了讲话。

sentences.en: As I speak right now, the city attorney is drafting an executive order.
sentences.zh: 就在我说话的时候，市检察官正在起草一份行政命令。

sentences.en: And said that we will ban chokeholds and strangleholds.
sentences.zh: 并表示我们将禁止锁喉和扼颈。

sentences.en: He wants to ban chokeholds in the Houston Police Department.
sentences.zh: 他希望在休斯敦警察局禁止锁喉行为。

sentences.en: And I have a resolution that will be presented to the family.
sentences.zh: 我还有一份将提交给家属的决议。

sentences.en: You had Congressman Al Green come up.
sentences.zh: 国会议员阿尔·格林（Al Green）上台了。

sentences.en: This resolution is going to say to those who look through the vista of time, that at this time there lived one among us who was a child of God who was taken untimely.
sentences.zh: 这份决议将告诉那些回望历史的人：在那个时代，我们中间曾生活着一个上帝的孩子，他过早地离开了我们。

sentences.en: But we are going to make sure that those who look through time, that they will know that he made a difference within his time because he changed not only this country,
sentences.zh: 但我们要确保那些回望历史的人知道，他在他的时代有所作为，因为他改变的不仅仅是这个国家，

sentences.en: not only the United States.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是美国。

sentences.en: He changed the world.
sentences.zh: 他改变了世界。

sentences.en: George Floyd changed the world.
sentences.zh: 乔治·弗洛伊德改变了世界。

sentences.en: And also...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Hello, everyone, on this day of prayer,
sentences.zh: 大家好，在这个祈祷的日子里，

sentences.en: where we try to understand God's plan in our pain.
sentences.zh: 我们试图在痛苦中理解上帝的计划。

sentences.en: Joe Biden made a video message.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登录制了一段视频信息。

sentences.en: Now is the time for racial justice.
sentences.zh: 现在是实现种族正义的时候了。

sentences.en: That's the answer we must give to our children when they ask why.
sentences.zh: 当我们的孩子问为什么时，这就是我们必须给他们的答案。

sentences.en: Because when there is justice for George Floyd,
sentences.zh: 因为当乔治·弗洛伊德得到正义时，

sentences.en: we will truly be on our way to racial justice in America.
sentences.zh: 我们将真正走上美国种族正义的道路。

sentences.en: And they all sort of talked about and told the family that his death would not be in vain.
sentences.zh: 他们都谈到了这一点，并告诉家属，他的死不会是徒劳的。

sentences.en: God bless you all.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你们所有人。

sentences.en: I want to ask the members of the family who are going to come up and speak at this time, if you would please make your way to the stage.
sentences.zh: 我想请准备上台发言的家属成员，请移步到舞台上。

sentences.en: And then after the first half of the funeral is sort of taken up by politicians...
sentences.zh: 葬礼的前半部分基本上是由政客们占据的……

sentences.en: Welcome, everyone.
sentences.zh: 欢迎大家。

sentences.en: I am George Floyd's aunt.
sentences.zh: 我是乔治·弗洛伊德的姑姑。

sentences.en: I just want to thank everybody.
sentences.zh: 我只想感谢大家。

sentences.en: And I would like to thank the whole world.
sentences.zh: 我想感谢全世界。

sentences.en: What it has done for my family today.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们今天为我的家人所做的一切。

sentences.en: The family sort of takes over.
sentences.zh: 家属们接过了话筒。

sentences.en: But I just want to make this statement.
sentences.zh: 我只想发表这个声明。

sentences.en: The world knows George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 全世界都认识乔治·弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: I know Perry Jr.
sentences.zh: 我认识小佩里（Perry Jr.）。

sentences.en: He was a pesky little rascal.
sentences.zh: 他是个淘气的小捣蛋鬼。

sentences.en: But we all loved him.
sentences.zh: 但我们都爱他。

sentences.en: And they sort of physically take over.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上接管了现场。

sentences.en: And they're up there as a group.
sentences.zh: 他们一群人站在台上。

sentences.en: I just want to say that I'm going to miss my brother a whole lot.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，我会非常想念我的兄弟。

sentences.en: And I love, I just want to say to him, I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱他，我只想对他说，我爱你。

sentences.en: And I thank God for giving me, giving me my own personal superman.
sentences.zh: 我感谢上帝给了我，给了我我自己的超人。

sentences.en: God bless you all.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你们所有人。

sentences.en: And they start talking about their brother and their uncle.
sentences.zh: 他们开始谈论他们的兄弟和叔叔。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Brooke Williams, George Floyd's niece.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是布鲁克·威廉姆斯（Brooke Williams），乔治·弗洛伊德的侄女。

sentences.en: And I can breathe.
sentences.zh: 我还能呼吸。

sentences.en: Long as I'm breathing, justice will be served for Perry.
sentences.zh: 只要我还在呼吸，佩里就会得到正义。

sentences.en: First off, I want to thank all of you for coming out to support George Perry Floyd.
sentences.zh: 首先，我要感谢你们所有人前来支持乔治·佩里·弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: My uncle was a father, brother, uncle, and a cousin to many.
sentences.zh: 我的叔叔是许多人的父亲、兄弟、叔叔和堂兄。

sentences.en: Spiritually grounded and activiSt.
sentences.zh: 他精神充实，是一位活动家。

sentences.en: He always moved people with his words.
sentences.zh: 他总是用言语打动人心。

sentences.en: You know, and it becomes very powerful to hear them talk in a very intimate way about their relative.
sentences.zh: 你知道，听到他们以非常亲密的方式谈论他们的亲人，这非常有力量。

sentences.en: My most favorite memory when my uncle was when he played, when he's paid me to scratch his head.
sentences.zh: 关于我叔叔，我最喜欢的记忆是他玩的时候，他付钱让我抓他的头。

sentences.en: After long days of work, we arrived at home.
sentences.zh: 辛苦工作一天后，我们回到家。

sentences.en: We even created a song about it called Scratch My Head, Scratch My Head, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至为此创作了一首歌，叫《抓抓我的头，抓抓我的头》，是的。

sentences.en: But after that, I knew he was a comedian.
sentences.zh: 但从那以后，我就知道他是个喜剧演员。

sentences.en: He always told me, baby girl, you're going to go so far with that beautiful smile and brains of yours.
sentences.zh: 他总是对我说，宝贝，凭你那美丽的笑容和聪明的头脑，你会走得很远。

sentences.en: Well, then fast forward to 1998, I started a college exhibition tour team touring around the country, going to play different colleges and exhibition games.
sentences.zh: 快进到1998年，我开始了一个大学表演巡回赛团队，在全国各地巡回，去不同的大学打表演赛。

sentences.en: In Big Floyd, that was my first power forward.
sentences.zh: 大弗洛伊德（Big Floyd），那是我的第一大前锋。

sentences.en: I would be calling around, trying to get contracts with the different schools.
sentences.zh: 我会到处打电话，试图与不同的学校签订合同。

sentences.en: And the coaches would ask me, who's your big man?
sentences.zh: 教练们会问我，你的大个子是谁？

sentences.en: I would say, George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 我会说，乔治·弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: They'd say, oh, you got Big Floyd.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，哦，你有大弗洛伊德。

sentences.en: Okay, well, your team must be pretty good.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那你们队一定很厉害。

sentences.en: And so then we would go off and play.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就去比赛了。

sentences.en: You know, and it was those little moments and those little anecdotes that really, I think, helped people get a sense of who George was.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正是那些小瞬间和那些小轶事，我认为真正帮助人们了解了乔治是个什么样的人。

sentences.en: Everybody know who Big Floyd is now.
sentences.zh: 现在每个人都知道大弗洛伊德是谁了。

sentences.en: Third Ward, CUNY home.
sentences.zh: 第三区，基尼家园。

sentences.en: As the family spoke.
sentences.zh: 当家属发言时。

sentences.en: From the CUNY home to Jack Yakes High.
sentences.zh: 从基尼家园到杰克·耶茨高中（Jack Yates High）。

sentences.en: You know, you really heard.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你真的听到了。

sentences.en: Third Ward and the CUNY homes to come and join me.
sentences.zh: 第三区和基尼家园的人都来加入我。

sentences.en: This sort of Third Ward pride come up.
sentences.zh: 这种第三区的自豪感油然而生。

sentences.en: In Third Ward, CUNY home, Texas.
sentences.zh: 在得克萨斯州第三区的基尼家园。

sentences.en: You know, very historic.
sentences.zh: 你知道，非常有历史意义。

sentences.en: Black elected officials live there.
sentences.zh: 黑人民选官员住在那儿。

sentences.en: It's home to the only Black-owned banking institution in Texas.
sentences.zh: 那里是得克萨斯州唯一一家黑人拥有的银行机构所在地。

sentences.en: Beyonce is from the Third Ward.
sentences.zh: 碧昂丝（Beyonce）就来自第三区。

sentences.en: It's just a place of a lot of Black pride and a lot of Black history.
sentences.zh: 那是一个充满黑人自豪感和黑人历史的地方。

sentences.en: At the same time, it's also a place of a lot of struggle and a lot of poverty.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，它也是一个充满挣扎和贫困的地方。

sentences.en: And there's a real strong sense that George Floyd is from this place that is a hard-fought and very proud place.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种强烈的共识，即乔治·弗洛伊德来自这个充满奋斗精神且令人自豪的地方。

sentences.en: Senior pastor, Pastor Remus Wright.
sentences.zh: 高级牧师，雷姆斯·赖特（Remus Wright）牧师。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: My privilege and my honor today.
sentences.zh: 今天对我来说是荣幸和殊荣。

sentences.en: You have the final eulogy.
sentences.zh: 你将听到最后的悼词。

sentences.en: A man who needs no introduction, but deserves one.
sentences.zh: 一个不需要介绍，但值得介绍的人。

sentences.en: Delivered by the Reverend Al Sharpton.
sentences.zh: 由阿尔·夏普顿（Al Sharpton）牧师致辞。

sentences.en: Al Sharpton.
sentences.zh: 阿尔·夏普顿。

sentences.en: And he appears he's standing there in a black and white preacher's robe.
sentences.zh: 他看起来身穿一件黑白相间的牧师长袍站在那里。

sentences.en: I hear people talk about what happened to George Floyd like there was something less than a crime.
sentences.zh: 我听到人们谈论乔治·弗洛伊德的遭遇时，仿佛那不仅仅是一场犯罪。

sentences.en: This was not just a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一场悲剧。

sentences.en: It was a crime.
sentences.zh: 这是一场犯罪。

sentences.en: And to me, there was just one moment early on.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，早期有一个瞬间。

sentences.en: You know, he's standing up there, and then he puts his glasses on, and he starts reading from this liSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他站在那里，戴上眼镜，开始照着一张单子念。

sentences.en: I give him recognition.
sentences.zh: 我向他致意。

sentences.en: I must also recognize several families are here.
sentences.zh: 我也必须向在场的几位家属致意。

sentences.en: As if he's going to thank some of the different people.
sentences.zh: 就好像他要感谢其中一些人一样。

sentences.en: And he starts talking about some of the people who are there.
sentences.zh: 他开始谈论在场的一些人。

sentences.en: And he says...
sentences.zh: 他说……

sentences.en: The mother of Trayvon Martin, will you stand?
sentences.zh: 特雷沃恩·马丁的母亲，请起立好吗？

sentences.en: The mother of Trayvon Martin, will you stand?
sentences.zh: 特雷沃恩·马丁的母亲，请起立好吗？

sentences.en: The mother...
sentences.zh: 母亲……

sentences.en: The mother of Eric Garner, will you stand?
sentences.zh: 埃里克·加纳的母亲，请起立好吗？

sentences.en: The mother of Eric Garner, will you stand?
sentences.zh: 埃里克·加纳的母亲，请起立好吗？

sentences.en: And he runs through this long liSt.
sentences.zh: 他念完了这一长串名单。

sentences.en: It's like a roll call.
sentences.zh: 就像在点名一样。

sentences.en: The sister of Bartham Jean, will you stand?
sentences.zh: 巴瑟姆·吉恩的姐姐，请起立好吗？

sentences.en: And people are cheering.
sentences.zh: 人们在欢呼。

sentences.en: The family of Pamela Turner right here in Houston, will you stand?
sentences.zh: 就在休斯敦的帕梅拉·特纳的家人，请起立好吗？

sentences.en: They are standing.
sentences.zh: 他们站起来了。

sentences.en: The crowd is standing.
sentences.zh: 人群站了起来。

sentences.en: The father of Michael Brown from Ferguson, Missouri, will you stand?
sentences.zh: 来自密苏里州弗格森的迈克尔·布朗的父亲，请起立好吗？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: They're all there.
sentences.zh: 他们都在那儿。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The father of Ahmaud Arbery, will you stand?
sentences.zh: 阿莫德·阿伯里的父亲，请起立好吗？

sentences.en: And to have all of them there at this funeral, they know the pain of this more than anyone.
sentences.zh: 能让他们所有人都参加这场葬礼，他们比任何人都更了解这种痛苦。

sentences.en: You know, and they have the right to be angrier than everyone else.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们比任何人都更有理由感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And yet here they are grieving with George Floyd's family.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们却在这里与乔治·弗洛伊德的家人一起哀悼。

sentences.en: And you realize that George Floyd is part of this family of victims that should not be a family.
sentences.zh: 你意识到乔治·弗洛伊德是这个受害者家庭的一部分，而这本不该成为一个家庭。

sentences.en: All of these families came to stand with this family.
sentences.zh: 所有这些家庭都来支持这个家庭。

sentences.en: Because they know better than anyone else the pain they will suffer from the loss that they have gone through.
sentences.zh: 因为他们比任何人都更清楚他们所经历的失去将带来的痛苦。

sentences.en: So there was one moment when I think Sharpton, you know, pulled together these two strands of the man and the symbol of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 所以有那么一刻，我认为夏普顿把乔治·弗洛伊德作为普通人和作为象征的这两个层面结合在了一起。

sentences.en: And that was a moment when Sharpton was alluding to George Floyd's arrest history.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，夏普顿提到了乔治·弗洛伊德的被捕记录。

sentences.en: If George Floyd had been an Ivy League school graduate and one of these ones with a long title, we would have been accused of reacting to his prominence.
sentences.zh: 如果乔治·弗洛伊德是常春藤盟校的毕业生，或者拥有某种显赫头衔的人，我们就会被指责是因为他的身份而做出反应。

sentences.en: If he'd been a multimillionaire, they would have said that we were reacting to his wealth.
sentences.zh: 如果他是个千万富翁，他们会说我们是因为他的财富而做出反应。

sentences.en: If he had been a famous athlete, as he was on the trajectory to be, we would have said we were reacting to his fame.
sentences.zh: 如果他是一位著名的运动员，正如他曾经有望成为的那样，我们会说我们是因为他的名气而做出反应。

sentences.en: But God took an ordinary brother.
sentences.zh: 但上帝带走了一个平凡的兄弟。

sentences.en: And he was sort of talking about him as an ordinary.
sentences.zh: 他当时谈论他时，就像谈论一个普通人。

sentences.en: From the third wall.
sentences.zh: 来自第三区。

sentences.en: Imperfect person.
sentences.zh: 一个不完美的人。

sentences.en: From the housing projects.
sentences.zh: 来自廉租房项目。

sentences.en: From the third wall projects.
sentences.zh: 来自第三区廉租房。

sentences.en: That nobody thought much about but those that knew him and loved him.
sentences.zh: 一个除了那些了解他、爱他的人之外，没人会多看一眼的人。

sentences.en: He took the rejected stone.
sentences.zh: 他带走了被遗弃的石头。

sentences.en: And it was a very powerful moment where he called George Floyd a rejected stone.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有力的时刻，他称乔治·弗洛伊德为被遗弃的石头。

sentences.en: You know, making a reference to scripture.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是在引用经文。

sentences.en: God took the rejected stone.
sentences.zh: 上帝带走了那块被遗弃的石头。

sentences.en: And made him the cornerstone of a movement that's going to change the whole wide world.
sentences.zh: 并使他成为一场将改变整个世界的运动的基石。

sentences.en: And how those officers may have thought that nobody cared about a guy like that.
sentences.zh: 那些警察可能以为没人会在乎那样的人。

sentences.en: Oh, if you had any idea.
sentences.zh: 噢，如果你能想到的话。

sentences.en: That all of us would react.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都会做出反应。

sentences.en: You took your knee off his neck.
sentences.zh: 你本该把膝盖从他的脖子上移开。

sentences.en: You know, and obviously the world knows now that the world did care about somebody like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，显然全世界现在都知道，世界确实在乎那样的人。

sentences.en: And how he died and how he was treated.
sentences.zh: 以及他是如何死去的，他是如何被对待的。

sentences.en: If you had any idea that preachers, white and black, was going to line up in a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 如果你能想到，在疫情期间，白人和黑人牧师会排起长队。

sentences.en: When we're told to stay inside.
sentences.zh: 当我们被告知待在家里时。

sentences.en: And we come out and march in the streets at the risk of our health.
sentences.zh: 我们却走出来，冒着健康风险在街上游行。

sentences.en: You'd have took your knee off his neck.
sentences.zh: 你本该把膝盖从他的脖子上移开。

sentences.en: Because you thought his neck didn't mean nothing.
sentences.zh: 因为你以为他的脖子一文不值。

sentences.en: But God made his neck to connect his head to his body.
sentences.zh: 但上帝创造他的脖子是为了连接他的头和身体。

sentences.en: And you have no right to put your knee on that neck.
sentences.zh: 你无权把膝盖压在那脖子上。

sentences.en: I think in the past, I think there has been this desire to like, you know, to only, you know, pay attention to sort of perfect victiMs.
sentences.zh: 我认为在过去，人们有一种倾向，只关注所谓的完美受害者。

sentences.en: So only to give attention to, you know, cases in which the person had this sort of, you know, holy life.
sentences.zh: 只关注那些生前过着所谓圣洁生活的人的案件。

sentences.en: And any rush with the law, no matter how many years ago, it somehow was thought to taint, you know, how people viewed whatever police killing was in the news.
sentences.zh: 而任何与法律的冲突，无论过去多少年，在某种程度上都被认为会玷污人们对新闻中任何警察杀人事件的看法。

sentences.en: And I think that shifted a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种情况已经有所改变。

sentences.en: And I see the difference in George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 我在乔治·弗洛伊德身上看到了这种不同。

sentences.en: Your family is going to miss you, George.
sentences.zh: 你的家人会想念你的，乔治。

sentences.en: But your nation is going to always remember your name.
sentences.zh: 但你的国家将永远记住你的名字。

sentences.en: And Sharpton ended his remarks by touching on this idea that George Floyd was imperfect.
sentences.zh: 夏普顿在结束发言时，触及了乔治·弗洛伊德并不完美这一观点。

sentences.en: And he still deserves the movement that was happening.
sentences.zh: 但他依然值得这场正在发生的运动。

sentences.en: So we're going to lay you near your mama now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在要让你安息在你妈妈身边了。

sentences.en: You called for mama.
sentences.zh: 你呼唤了妈妈。

sentences.en: We're going to lay your body next to her.
sentences.zh: 我们要把你的遗体安葬在她旁边。

sentences.en: But I know mama's already embraced you, George.
sentences.zh: 但我知道妈妈已经拥抱你了，乔治。

sentences.en: You fought a good fight.
sentences.zh: 你打了一场美好的仗。

sentences.en: You kept the faith.
sentences.zh: 你坚守了信仰。

sentences.en: You finished your course.
sentences.zh: 你跑完了你的路程。

sentences.en: Go on and get your rest now.
sentences.zh: 去休息吧。

sentences.en: Go on and see mama now.
sentences.zh: 去见妈妈吧。

sentences.en: We're going to fight on.
sentences.zh: 我们要继续战斗。

sentences.en: We're going to fight on.
sentences.zh: 我们要继续战斗。

sentences.en: We're going to fight on.
sentences.zh: 我们要继续战斗。

sentences.en: We're going to fight on.
sentences.zh: 我们要继续战斗。

sentences.en: I want to speak to y'all real quick.
sentences.zh: 我想和你们简单说几句。

sentences.en: I just want to say, man, that I got my shortcomings and my flaws.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，伙计，我也有我的缺点和不足。

sentences.en: I ain't better than nobody else.
sentences.zh: 我并不比别人强。

sentences.en: But, man, the shootings that's going on, man, I don't care.
sentences.zh: 但是，伙计，现在发生的枪击事件，伙计，我不在乎。

sentences.en: What hood you from, man?
sentences.zh: 你来自哪个街区，伙计？

sentences.en: Where you at, man?
sentences.zh: 你在哪儿，伙计？

sentences.en: I love you and God love you, man.
sentences.zh: 我爱你，上帝也爱你，伙计。

sentences.en: Put them guns down, man.
sentences.zh: 放下枪吧，伙计。

sentences.en: That ain't what it is.
sentences.zh: 那不是解决之道。

sentences.en: You know, God bless, man.
sentences.zh: 你知道，上帝保佑，伙计。

sentences.en: And y'all hold y'all head up, man.
sentences.zh: 你们都要振作起来，伙计。

sentences.en: You got parents out here sitting in place, man, trying to bury their kids, man.
sentences.zh: 你们有父母在这里坐着，伙计，试图埋葬他们的孩子，伙计。

sentences.en: Think about it, man.
sentences.zh: 想想看，伙计。

sentences.en: Love y'all.
sentences.zh: 爱你们。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: On Tuesday morning, President Trump endorsed a conspiracy theory that a 75-year-old man who police were filmed pushing to the ground during a protest in Buffalo last week
sentences.zh: 周二上午，特朗普总统支持了一个阴谋论，称一名75岁的老人，即上周在布法罗抗议活动中被拍到被警察推倒在地的那位，

sentences.en: had been using his cell phone to knock out law enforcement radios on behalf of the Antifa movement.
sentences.zh: 一直在利用他的手机代表“反法西斯运动”（Antifa）干扰执法部门的无线电通讯。

sentences.en: In a tweet, the president offered no evidence of the theory, but named a right-wing news organization, One America News Network, in his tweet.
sentences.zh: 在推文中，总统没有提供该理论的任何证据，但在推文中点名了一个右翼新闻机构——“一个美国新闻网”（One America News Network）。

sentences.en: Did you have a reaction to the president's tweet earlier?
sentences.zh: 你对总统早些时候的推文有什么反应吗？

sentences.en: I learned a long time ago not to comment on tweets, and I'm not going to break that.
sentences.zh: 我很久以前就学会了不对推文发表评论，我不会打破这个原则。

sentences.en: But they are official statements.
sentences.zh: 但它们是官方声明。

sentences.en: Later in the day, Republican lawmakers and administration officials, including the White House chief of staff,
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，共和党议员和政府官员，包括白宫幕僚长，

sentences.en: Mark Meadows, dodged questions from reporters.
sentences.zh: 马克·梅多斯，回避了记者的提问。

sentences.en: The man who was injured in the incident, Martin Gugino, is still recovering in the hospital from a serious head injury.
sentences.zh: 在事件中受伤的男子马丁·古吉诺目前仍在医院康复，他头部受了重伤。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a police officer in New York City was arrested and charged with assault on Tuesday after shoving a young woman to the ground, giving her a concussion.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，周二，纽约市一名警察因将一名年轻女子推倒在地导致其脑震荡而被捕并被控袭击罪。

sentences.en: Another scene that was filmed on a cell phone.
sentences.zh: 这是另一个被手机拍下的场景。

sentences.en: Five states held their primary elections on Tuesday, including Georgia,
sentences.zh: 周二有五个州举行了初选，其中包括佐治亚州，

sentences.en: where a new voting system put into place in 2018 after claims of voter suppression experienced catastrophic meltdowns.
sentences.zh: 该州在2018年因选民压制指控而启用的新投票系统经历了灾难性的崩溃。

sentences.en: State-ordered voting machines were said to be missing or malfunctioning, causing voters to wait in line for hours at polling places across the state.
sentences.zh: 据称，州政府订购的投票机丢失或发生故障，导致全州各地的选民在投票站排队等候了数小时。

sentences.en: Some gave up and left before casting a vote.
sentences.zh: 一些人放弃并离开了，没能投出选票。

sentences.en: The problems were made worse by the coronavirus pandemic, which left fewer poll workers available than usual and added to wait times because machines had to be disinfected.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情加剧了这些问题，导致工作人员比平时更少，而且由于机器需要消毒，排队时间也增加了。

sentences.en: Predominantly Black areas of Georgia experienced some of the worst obstacles to voting, raising concerns that the problems would further disenfranchise Black voters.
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州以黑人为主的地区遭遇了一些最严重的投票障碍，引发了人们对这些问题将进一步剥夺黑人选民权利的担忧。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Caitlin Dickerson.
sentences.zh: 我是凯特琳·迪克森。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
